description: C03 V2 camera with dimensioned 11 x 14 mm tabbed PCB, 15 mm optical-axis depth, 10 mm lens, exposed components and recessed optical elements.

provenance.feature: PCB width, total height, lens OD and depth
provenance.note: References the published 11 x 14 mm PCB, 10 mm lens OD and 15 mm PCB-reference-to-lens-front depth. Lens front is exactly on the architecture anchor; rotation maps local cylinder Z onto +Y/up at the selected 25 degree tilt.
Camera front and PCB centers are the frozen shared anchors. The selected documented 25 degree canopy setting is an assembly estimate, not an independently measured stock pose.
Lower connection tab and exposed edge passives follow the C03 V2 photograph. Corner cuts, 0.8 mm board thickness and all package dimensions are estimates.
Stepped barrel, focus rings, black recessed cup and green/coated small lens elements reproduce visible structure. No optical prescription, thread standard or hidden sensor geometry is claimed.

Main integrator replaced the flat green face treatment with a smaller convex glass element and darker recessed pupil/coating. Published10mm barrel and15mm depth unchanged; optical dimensions and tint remain unmeasured.

nodes.notes: The full 11 x 14 mm outline includes the lower connection tab. PCB thickness is estimated at 0.8 mm.
